how.title: How Tipster Support works
how.s1: Unlock it: verify your ID and win 10 picks in a row on matches played in the last 30 days. One pick per match counts, and wins below the minimum odds don't.
how.s2: Set your offer: a price per copied pick, a weekly price, a monthly price, or any mix.
how.s3: Members back you with PuntPoints. Each new pick you post is copied to their list with an alert, plus any supporters-only note.
how.s4: Payments are held, never trusted. Per-pick payments release when the pick settles and are refunded if it is void. Weekly and monthly payments are refunded in full if no picks arrive.
how.proTitle: Free for everyone, better with Pro
how.pro: Any verified member can unlock Tipster Support and back tipsters. Puntr Pro members can back up to {{limitPro}} tipsters at once (free members {{limitFree}}) and keep 100% of support as tipsters ({{feeFree}}% platform fee on the free plan).
how.safe: Picks stay public and permanent. Copied picks never count on the supporter's own record. Accounts must be 14 days old, PuntPoints are never cash, and there is a monthly cap on what you can put towards Tipster Support.
